patthana15.7:1.1: hetuṃ pītisahagataṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na hetu na pītisahagato dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, tīṇi.
patthana15.7:2.1: hetuṃ sukhasahagataṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na hetu na sukhasahagato dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, tīṇi.
patthana15.7:3.1: hetuṃ upekkhāsahagataṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na hetu na upekkhāsahagato dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, tīṇi.
